build_BBoxL1Cost: build a BBoxL1Cost instance to compute L1 distance match cost between predicted and ground truth bounding boxes
create_IoUCost: create an IoUCost instance to compute negative IoU or GIoU match cost for bounding box assignment
test_ClassificationCost: test the ClassificationCost class to compute softmax-based classification match cost between predicted scores and ground truth labels
refactor_FocalLossCost: refactor the FocalLossCost class to compute focal loss match cost for label or mask-based instance assignment
review_DiceCost: review the DiceCost class to compute dice loss match cost for mask-based instance assignment in segmentation tasks
